name: Kousaka Sarasa
source:
A little devilish girl who charms men with her bewitching beauty that belies her age.
Although she has a slender model body, she has curves that shows off her body, and a beauty that combines loveliness and luster, making her equally popular among the boys in the school.
She is aware that she has good looks and is used to being admired by men, so she is fundamentally attracted to the opposite sex.
In addition, she is a genius who can do most things better than most people, and because she doesn't really put in any effort, she has little interest in anything and has a lazy side.
On the other hand, she also has an honest side that devotes herself wholeheartedly to things that interest her.
